title: MV Event Images Unaffected by Galv's Visibility Range

posts.author: prariepixel
posts.body: I am very new to RPG Maker (MV), so I apologise if this is going to have a silly solution. Galv's Visibility Range is working like a treat, aside from the fact that event images are unaffected by the overlay. Is there anything I can do about this?

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: What did you set the Z layer in the plugin settings?

posts.author: prariepixel
posts.body:
rpgLord69 said:
What did you set the Z layer in the plugin settings?
Click to expand...
The Z position value in the plugin settings is set to 3.
